name_input: ROTOMAG MOTORS AND CONTROLS PRIVATE LIMITED; Rotomag Enertec Limited
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records for ROTOMAG ENERTEC LIMITED (same group, Vithal Udyognagar GIDC, Anand): "2026-02-28 ROTOMAG ENERTEC LIMITED VILMA AB DC MOTOR-0.24HP/0.185KW,24Volt,1600RPM,Model-0AB3.24024160CU ... NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India Vilnius, LITHUANIA 85013119 1135091" — export B/L 1135091, HS 85013119, destination Lithuania, dated 2026-02-28. Further export rows seen: 2026-02-27 to ALFRED KARCHER SE AND CO.KG, Hamburg GERMANY, HS 85013119, B/L 1084454; 2026-02-26 to VINCKE HYDRAULICS S.A., Barcelona SPAIN, HS 85013210, B/L 1055311; 2026-02-23 to EURO MOTORS ITALIA S.P.A., Milan ITALY, HS 85013119, B/L 9914620. For ROTOMAG MOTORS AND CONTROLS PRIVATE LIMITED the same page lists export buyers SLEIPNER MOTOR AS (Fredrikstad, Norway, 163 shipments), ARGO HYTOS S.R.O. (Czech Republic, 65), DIVERSEY EUROPE B.V. (Switzerland, 33), VILMA AB (Lithuania, 39), TRANSCOVER SYSTEMS LIMITED (UK, 26). Source counter: ImportKey states "Total Shipments 424" for Rotomag Enertec and "Total Shipments 1191" for Rotomag Motors and Controls; rows actually visible on the free view: 5 shipment rows for Enertec, 5 for Motors and Controls (free view is truncated, full row set not public).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split was found in the sources read. ImportKey shows only customs (import/export) records, not domestic supply. Note: the import side is heavily documented (e.g. "2025-08-25 DONGYANG YILI MAGNETIC INDUSTRY CO., LTD -> ROTOMAG MOTORS AND CONTROLS PRIVATE LIMITED ... SHANGHAI, China Bombay Air, India 85051190 56342089"), which proves an operating manufacturing/assembly base at 2102/3&4 Vithal Udyognagar, near GIDC, but is not itself domestic-sales evidence.
note: Real shipments confirmed, not just claims: dated export customs entries with B/L numbers, HS codes and named European destinations exist for both Rotomag Enertec Limited and Rotomag Motors and Controls Private Limited. Declared HS set (840910;847190;850131;854370) is partly corroborated — 850131 is the dominant actual export code (85013119/85013210, DC motors); 840910, 847190 and 854370 were not seen in any visible record, so the HS list should be treated as partly unverified rather than corrected outright. Group structure: Rotomag Motors and Controls Pvt Ltd and Rotomag Enertec Ltd share the Vithal Udyognagar GIDC (Anand, Gujarat) address and overlapping Chinese suppliers (Dongyang Yili Magnetic, Nantong Bicheng, Ningbo Sunico), indicating one operating group. Declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) does not match the observed product line (DC electric motors, motor parts, magnets) — actual activity is electrical machinery / motor manufacturing. Domestic supply evidence: not public in the sources checked — null, no figure invented. No sanctions, court or liquidation findings were assessed here (out of scope for this role).
